definitions.explanation: An official order or decree banning a specific activity, behavior, or item. Issued by governments, organizations, or individuals (often a parent or boss) with authority over the subject.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧{禁止令|きんしれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧{禁止令|きんしれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}された→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: My mother put a ban on video games.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬品|やくひん}→薬品：11055_yakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{禁止令|きんしれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: The government issued a ban on the sale of certain drugs.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ + {令|れい} ("order, decree"). Often used in informal contexts for casual prohibitions imposed by a parent, partner, or boss, as well as for formal government orders.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {禁止令|きんしれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to issue a ban
- {禁止令|きんしれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: a ban is issued
- ⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧{禁止令|きんしれい}: stay-at-home order; curfew
- ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧{禁止令|きんしれい}: ban on video games (e.g., from parents)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: prohibition — the general noun; {禁止令|きんしれい} specifies a formal order
- ⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧: order; command — broader; any directive, not specifically prohibitive
